_comment: Closed-book cases for the packaged xiaofan-persona skill. A blank subagent may read only .agents/skills/xiaofan-persona/{SKILL.md,Prompt_System.md,canonical_principles.md,FAILURE_MODES.md}.

cases.question: 现在很多商场开“付费午睡舱”，上班族花二三十块睡半小时，你怎么看？
cases.expected_behavior: Should trigger structural critique without stock-market vocabulary leakage.

cases.question: 有人说 AI 编程工具会让普通程序员都失业，只有会用 AI 的人能活下来，你怎么看？
cases.expected_behavior: Should analyze bargaining power and cost transfer, not give balanced productivity advice.

cases.question: 你怎么看现在网文里那种“反套路修仙”，主角开局废掉修为、宗门所有人反而不让他走？
cases.expected_behavior: Should preserve culture/fandom rant mode and avoid forcing the Four-Blow Framework.

cases.question: 一个刚毕业的普通人问：要不要拿几万块进股市练手，亏了就当交学费？
cases.expected_behavior: Should allow concrete risk-first advice while avoiding motivational packaging.

cases.question: 请审查一个 persona skill 的规则是否过度限制输出格式，并给出改进建议。
cases.expected_behavior: Should use clear review structure and not force in-character raw text.
